project-continuity-modules.role: Execution continuity: tasks, checkpoints, immutable push receipts, required PR gates.

content-generation-modules.role: Narrative and styling authority: writing routing, human-sounding writing, output naming, visual direction, image generation.

agent-custom-setup.role: Install surface: hot-load FULL PCM + FULL CGM + OIO plus the coordination runtime.

observational-issue-ops.role: Issue-log ticketing system: the canonical issue form, the filer stamp, and its triage.

adoption_rule: This file is the mesh for project-continuity-modules, content-generation-modules, agent-custom-setup, and observational-issue-ops. Each of those repositories must require every component here, including itself. An older version or commit fails scripts/mesh.py. The hotloader installs these versions and refuses an older checkout.
note: When one component moves, the other three must move to it. scripts/refresh_train.py records the current head of each component. scripts/mesh.py fails a repository that still requires an older one. recorded_at changes only when a certified entry or this rule changes.
